settings.hero_desc: A detailed miniature of a construction vibrohammer, finished in signature red and presented under a clear case on a branded base. A standout corporate gift and showcase piece for construction-equipment makers and rental firms.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your equipment, branding, colours and display case
settings.s1_body: Hard to gift a piece of heavy construction equipment - easy to gift its miniature. We recreate your vibrohammer to scale, in your brand colours, and seal it under a clear case on a branded base. The result is a memorable client gift, exhibition giveaway or reception showpiece that keeps your equipment in front of customers long after the meeting.
settings.case_heading: Vibrohammer Became the Talk of the Mining Exhibition
settings.case_body: Produced as 50 qty of branded corporate gifts for PTC in their mining exhibition, these miniatures put the firm's machine on clients' desks - a tangible, on-brand reminder that outlasts any brochure or pen.
settings.case_quote: Clients loved getting a miniature of the actual machine we supply. All the other exhibitors were asking who made these miniatures, but that's our trade secret.
settings.case_quote_attr: Mohammed Ranees - Operations Manager at PTC
settings.prov_p: Construction of any property starts with the foundation and piling. This is done by machines like the vibrohammer, which drives the piles and helps set the concrete foundation - leading to a sturdy structure on top.
